clips.title: The story
paras: In Northshire Abbey, the Library Wing gathers scholars and new priests and mages. Its quiet southern rooms offer instruction for those joining Stormwind’s defense.

The Library Wing branches south from Northshire Abbey’s Main Hall. Dusty shelves, study lecterns, and quiet alcoves fill its rooms, where aspiring mages and priests learn the Arcane and the Holy Light. Across the abbey, martial recruits drill in the Hall of Arms. Priestess Anetta guides novice priests in faith and healing, while Khelden Bremen teaches budding mages to shape primal elemental energy.
